title: TopologyV2Node
description: Topology v2 node (vertex). Networking nuance is expressed as labels/tags/properties, not schema types.

id.description: Stable node identifier within the topology domain. Recommended pattern: derive from a canonical ref when possible, e.g. `ref:<ref.type>:<ref.id>`. For derived/computed nodes, use deterministic ids (composite key or hash) so annotations and diffing work over time.

labels.description: Structured metadata for filtering/grouping and view logic.

properties.description: Arbitrary rich attributes (numbers, nested objects, arrays).

refs.description: External reference anchors for composition, drilldowns, and linking to upstream systems. Include at least one canonical inventory ref when available (e.g., inventory.device, inventory.interface). `refs` is not used by the UI for rendering directly; it is primarily for back-end composition/join and for stable mapping across producers.
